# e2b_access_token (Resource)

Creates and deletes an E2B access token. E2B does not expose read/list/update for access tokens, so Terraform preserves state after creation and can delete by ID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "e2b_access_token" "automation" {
  name = "terraform-automation"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Access token name.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Timestamp when the access token was created.
- `id` (String) Access token ID.
- `mask_prefix` (String) Token type prefix in E2B's masked token metadata.
- `mask_value_length` (Number) Original token length in E2B's masked token metadata.
- `masked_value_prefix` (String) Visible prefix in E2B's masked token metadata.
- `masked_value_suffix` (String) Visible suffix in E2B's masked token metadata.
- `token` (String, Sensitive) Raw access token value. E2B only returns this value at creation time.
